data.title: 爱西亚 · 浅海清波中荷叶边泳衣的羞涩戏水
data.description: 热带清澈见底的浅滩上，爱西亚穿着保守而纯洁的纯白荷叶边连体泳衣，双手小心翼翼捧起海水，微风吹拂金色发丝。
data.location: 清澈如琉璃的热带海滨浅滩
data.action: 站在及踝海水中微屈双膝，双手舀起透明海水，羞涩地转头注视，双颊泛起粉嫩红晕
data.lighting: 明净的白日日光，海水波光折射出剔透如宝石的微芒
data.camera: 全身侧视，构图纯粹干净，突显无邪少女感
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, asia argento, blonde hair tied with white ribbons, bright green eyes, modest pure white one-piece swimsuit with frilly ruffles, wading in crystal-clear ankle-deep turquoise ocean water, scooping up sea water with delicate hands, blushing shyly, soft sea breeze, tropical white sand beach under pale blue sky, innocent beauty.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, asia argento, blonde hair, pure white ruffled one-piece swimsuit, splashing in clear turquoise shallow sea.
